content: The Salon demo offers haircuts, blowouts, hair color, manicures, and facials.
Haircuts start at $45. Blowouts start at $40. Hair color starts at $95. Manicures start at $30. Facials start at $85.
Salon demo hours are Tuesday through Saturday from 10 AM to 7 PM. The salon is closed Sunday and Monday.
Salon appointments should be cancelled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance. Color appointments may require a consultation before booking.
Haircuts usually take 45 minutes. Blowouts usually take 40 minutes. Hair color can take 90 to 150 minutes depending on the service.
